HediffDef.label: social matrix
HediffDef.description: An advanced engram-routing matrix wired into the jaw assembly, enabling nuanced communication and diplomatic processing beyond basic vox-emission.

HediffDef.label: Lifeless
HediffDef.description: The spark did not transfer. The frame works, but nothing behind it cares — no surge of drive, no moment of clarity, no inspiration ever rises from the lattice. It simply continues.

HediffDef.label: Lych Guard
HediffDef.description: The reinforced necrodermis chassis seals damage faster than lighter frames — wounds clot into slag and re-knit without core flux loss. The living metal dedicates significant molecular resources to structural repair, recovering injuries at an accelerated rate.

HediffDef.label: Deathmark chassis
HediffDef.description: The Deathmark frame channels molecular repair into its skeletal lattice — injuries reseal without core flux loss and the living metal re-knits at an elevated rate. The chassis is optimized for sustained independent operation deep in hostile territory.

HediffDef.label: Cryptek lattice
HediffDef.description: The Cryptek's crystalline frame is threaded with self-correcting molecular architecture — damage is re-knit at an elevated rate and the lattice does not bleed. The same arcane substrate that grants etheric capacity also sustains the body's structural cohesion.

HediffDef.label: Overlord carapace
HediffDef.description: The Overlord's Sempiternal Weave is not merely decorative — the layered necrodermis baffles redirect molecular repair to where it is needed most, accelerating wound closure and eliminating core flux loss entirely. To wound an Overlord is to inconvenience one.

HediffDef.label: body degradation
HediffDef.description: The living metal lattice is starving for fresh necrodermis. Structural integrity fails faster until material is assimilated; aggression protocols spike as the mind fights for control.\n\nFrom light severity onward, the frame diverts more power to hold itself together, so core flux drains faster until necrodermis reserves are restored. Cognition penalties from low power are expressed through core flux strain, not the lattice itself.

li.label: moderate
li.extraTooltip: Core flux loss ramps up sharply at this stage; power is being diverted to slow lattice collapse. Refill necrodermis and consider stasis before flux bottoms out.

li.label: severe
li.extraTooltip: Core flux decay is severe. Without necrodermis or a full stasis cycle, shutdown from flux exhaustion will follow soon after the lattice gives way.

li.label: critical
li.extraTooltip: Critical lattice failure: core flux is collapsing as fast as the body can spare energy. Assimilate necrodermis immediately - Eternal Slumber is eminent.

HediffDef.label: dynastic resonance
HediffDef.description: The dynasty sings. All needs are satisfied; ancient memories surface with perfect clarity, and the will crystallises into something cold and absolute.

li.label: dynastic resonance
li.description: All needs are satisfied. The dynasty's will flows through me — I am exactly what I was made to be.

HediffDef.label: The Sorrow
HediffDef.description: The organic self was not erased by Biotransference — it was indebted. Every memory of warmth, connection, and sensation that the living body ever held is an outstanding ledger that the metal cannot pay. Soul-Debt does not forget. It collects.

li.label: intrusion
li.extraTooltip: Soul-Debt is surfacing. Phantom sensations and the faces of the long-dead press against the cognitive lattice unbidden.

li.label: immersion
li.extraTooltip: The Sorrow has taken hold. The pawn is lost in another life — another body, another world. Soul-Debt is collecting in full.

li.label: echoes of Soul-Debt
li.description: Phantom warmth. A name I can no longer place. The living body left a ledger and the metal cannot pay it.

li.label: Soul-Debt surfacing
li.description: The memories are forcing themselves forward. Faces. Sensation. A life I surrendered. I cannot make it stop.

li.label: lost in The Sorrow
li.description: I am somewhere else entirely. The debt has come due and there is nothing left to pay it with but everything I once was.

HediffDef.label: Nobility
HediffDef.description: Noble memory engrams, preserved with perfect fidelity across sixty million years, demand stimulation that this diminished age cannot provide. The intellect is vast; the options are few. Joy bleeds away steadily, and when the ledger of inadequacy reaches its limit, the dynasty's pride fractures into something uglier.

HediffDef.label: reanimation cooldown
HediffDef.description: The reanimation protocol has recently fired. The living metal matrix requires thirty days of continuous operation — or a complete stasis cycle — to rebuild the stored energy needed to reassemble from critical damage a second time.
